questions.text:
कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दिए गए पदों के समूह में से सही युग्म का चयन करें :

कॉलम-I | कॉलम-II
(a) गैर-कर राजस्व | (i) वस्तु व सेवा कर
(b) अप्रत्यक्ष कर | (ii) मुफ्त खोर (Free-rider)
(c) पूँजीगत व्यय | (iii) ऋण
(d) निजी वस्तुएँ | (iv) प्रतिद्वंद्वात्मक प्रकृति
विकल्प :
(A) (a) (i)
(B) (b)(ii)
(C) (c) - (iii)
(D) (d) - (iv)
questions.text_english:
From the set of terms given in Column-I and Column-II, choose the correct pair:

Column-I | Column-II
(a) Non-tax Revenue | (i) Goods and Services Tax
(b) Indirect Tax | (ii) Free-rider
(c) Capital expenditure | (iii) Borrowings
(d) Private goods | (iv) Rivalrous in nature
Options:
(A) (a) (i)
(B) (b)(ii)
(C) (c)- (iii)
(D) (d) - (iv)
questions.solution: Option (C) is correct because capital expenditure includes items like repayment of loans (borrowings). The other pairs are incorrect matches for their respective categories in public finance.

questions.text: यदि कोई राष्ट्र ₹ 600 करोड़ का माल निर्यात करता है तथा ₹ 450 करोड़ का माल आयात करता है, तो राष्ट्र के व्यापार संतुलन का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ का होगा ।
questions.text_english: If a country exports goods worth of 600 crores and imports goods worth of 450 crores, the value of Balance of Trade of the country would be _______ crores.
questions.solution: Balance of Trade (BOT) is calculated as Exports - Imports. Here, 600 - 450 = 150. Since exports exceed imports, it is a surplus of 150.

questions.text:
वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सत्य हैं ?
(I) बैंकों के लिए जमाएँ देनदारियाँ होती हैं।
(II) वे अर्थव्यवस्था में साख सृजक होते हैं।
(III) वे आम जनता से जमा स्वीकार करते हैं।
(IV) वे भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक की ओर से जमा स्वीकार करते हैं।
questions.text_english:
In the context of the Commercial Banks, which of the following statements are correct?
(I) Deposits received are liabilities for Commercial Banks.
(II) They are creator of credit in the economy.
(III) They accept deposits from general public.
(IV) They accept deposits on behalf of Reserve Bank of India.
questions.solution: Statements I, II, and III are correct functions and characteristics of commercial banks. Statement IV is incorrect as banks accept deposits for themselves, not on behalf of RBI.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, औसत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (APC) का मूल्य 0.8 है तथा राष्ट्रीय आय ₹4,000 करोड़ है, तो बचत का मूल्य ₹ _______ करोड़ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the value of Average Propensity to Consume (APC) is 0.8 and National Income is 4,000 crores, the value of saving would be _______ crores.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों-अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) का अध्ययन करें। अभिकथन (A) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ वे वस्तुएँ हैं, जिनका उपभोग जनता द्वारा सामूहिक रूप से किया जाता है। कारण (R) : सार्वजनिक वस्तुएँ बहिष्कृत एवं प्रतिद्वन्द्वात्मक प्रकृति की होती हैं।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements: Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): Public goods are those goods that are collectively consumed by the public. Reason (R): Public goods are excludable and rivalrous in nature.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Public goods are non-excludable and non-rivalrous, so Reason (R) is false while Assertion (A) is true.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था का बचत वक्र ₹ 50 करोड़ के ऋणात्मक मूल्य पर अवरोध (intercept) बनता है। अर्थव्यवस्था में, आय में वृद्धि का 20% बचत के रूप में रखा जाता है। निवेश गुणक (K) के मूल्य की पहचान करें।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the saving curve of an economy makes an intercept at a negative value of 50 crores. In the economy, 20% of an increase in income is saved. Identify the value of investment multiplier (K).
questions.solution: MPS = 20% = 0.2. Investment Multiplier (K) = 1/MPS = 1/0.2 = 5.

questions.text: इरफान (एक छात्र) ने अपनी कॉलेज की फीस के लिए ₹80,000 का ऋण लिया है। वह स्नातक होने के छह माह बाद ऋण चुकाना प्रारंभ करने की योजना बना रहा है, जिसे वह 10 वर्ष की अवधि में चुकाएगा। उपरोक्त गद्य के आधार पर मुद्रा के निर्दिष्ट कार्य की पहचान करें ।
questions.text_english: Irfaan (a student) borrows 80,000 to finance his college fee. He plans to begin repaying the loan six months after his graduation, making payments over a span of ten years. Based on above text, identify the indicated function of money.
questions.solution: The ability to defer payments over time is a standard function of money, termed as 'Standard of Deferred Payments'.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें : कथन 1: प्रबंधित तिरती विनिमय दर प्रणाली स्थिर व नम्य विनिमय दर प्रणाली का एक समामेलन है। कथन 2 : प्रबंधित तिरती विनिमय दर प्रणाली को 'हाईब्रिड प्रणाली' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है।
questions.text_english: Read the following statements carefully: Statement-1 : Managed floating exchange rate system is an amalgamation of fixed and flexible exchange rate system. Statement-2: Managed floating exchange rate system is also known as 'hybrid system'.

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Managed floating system combines features of fixed and flexible systems and is indeed called a hybrid system, so both statements are true.

questions.text:
कॉलम-I व कॉलम-II में दी गई मदों में से सही युग्म का चयन कीजिए :
कॉलम-I | कॉलम-II
(a) संपत्ति से आय | (i) वृद्धावस्था पेंशन
(b) उद्यमशीलता से आय | (ii) लाभ
(c) मिश्रित आय | (iii) नियोक्ता द्वारा प्रदत्त किराया मुक्त आवास
(d) कर्मचारियों का मुआवजा | (iv) पूँजी पर ब्याज
questions.text_english:
From the items given in Column-I and Column-II, choose the correct pair.
Column-I | Column-II
(a) Income from Property | (i) Old age pension
(b) Income from Entrepreneurship | (ii) Profit
(c) Mixed Income | (iii) Rent free accommodation from an employer
(d) Compensation of Employees | (iv) Interest from capital
questions.solution: Income from entrepreneurship is represented by profit (b-ii). Other pairs do not align with standard national income components.

questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन के चालू खाते लेनदेन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से असत्य कथन की पहचान करें :
questions.text_english: In the context of Current Account transactions of Balance of Payment, identify the incorrect statement from the following:

options.A: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के निर्यात को क्रेडिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किया जाता है।
options.B: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के आयात को डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किया जाता है।
options.C: सभी हस्तांतरण भुगतान डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज किए जाते हैं।
options.D: सभी हस्तांतरण प्राप्तियाँ डेबिट मदों के रूप में दर्ज की जाती हैं।

options_english.A: Export of goods and services are recorded as credit items.
options_english.B: Import of goods and services are recorded as debit items.
options_english.C: All transfer payments are recorded as debit items.
options_english.D: All transfer receipts are recorded as debit items.

questions.solution: Transfer receipts are inflows of money, therefore they should be recorded as credit items, not debit items. Hence, D is incorrect.

questions.text: "सरकार ने देश के विभिन्न भागों में पर्यटन को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए 'अतुल्य भारत' अभियान प्रारंभ किया था।" उपरोक्त अभियान के भारतीय विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार तथा भुगतान संतुलन पर पड़ने वाले प्रभावों को विस्तार से उल्लेखित करें ।
questions.text_english: "The Government had launched Incredible India Campaign to promote tourism in various parts of the country." Elaborate the impact of this campaign on foreign exchange reserves and Balance of Payment of India.

key_points: Increase in foreign tourist arrivals leads to higher inflows of foreign currency.
This strengthens the foreign exchange reserves of the country.
Tourism is a credit item in the invisible account of the balance of payments, improving the current account balance.

questions.solution: The Incredible India campaign boosts foreign tourist arrivals in India, which directly increases the inflow of foreign currency. This influx of foreign exchange strengthens the country's foreign exchange reserves. In the context of the Balance of Payments, tourism receipts are classified as invisible exports recorded on the credit side of the current account. Consequently, an increase in these receipts improves India's current account balance by reducing a deficit or increasing a surplus.

questions.text: (a) "सक्षम के पास एक विनिर्माण सुविधा है, जहाँ माइक्रोचिप्स का उपयोग कम्प्यूटर व स्मार्टफोन सहित इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरणों के उत्पादन में किया जाता है।" उपरोक्त गद्य से पहचान करें कि, यह कथन मध्यवर्ती वस्तुओं को संदर्भित करता है अथवा अंतिम वस्तुओं को । अपने उत्तर के समर्थन में वैध कारण दें।
questions.text_english: (a) "Saksham owns a manufacturing facility where microchips are utilized in the production of electronic devices, including computers and smartphones." From the above text, identify whether the given statement refers to an intermediate goods or final goods. Give valid reason in support of your answer.

key_points: They are used as raw materials in the production of final goods like smartphones.
Their value is already included in the price of the final product.

questions.solution: The microchips mentioned are intermediate goods. This is because they are not consumed directly by the end-user but are utilized as raw materials or components in the production process of finished electronic devices like computers and smartphones. Since their value is already embedded in the final price of the product, counting them separately would lead to double counting.

questions.text: 'वर्ष 2023-24 के लिए केन्द्र सरकार के राजकोषीय विवरण में उर्वरकों पर उपदान एक महत्त्वपूर्ण घटक था ।' उपरोक्त सरकारी व्यय की प्रकृति व उसके उद्देश्य की पहचान करें ।
questions.text_english: "A significant proportion of subsidies on fertilizer was a key component of the fiscal statement of the Central Government for year 2023-24." Identify the nature of government expenditure and its objective.

key_points: Objective: Social welfare and agricultural productivity.
Objective: Reducing cost of production for farmers.

questions.solution: Subsidies on fertilizers represent revenue expenditure for the government because they do not lead to the creation of any physical or financial assets. The primary objective of this expenditure is social welfare and enhancing agricultural productivity. By providing cheaper inputs, the government aims to reduce the cost of production for farmers, thereby making food production more affordable for the masses and supporting agricultural income.

questions.text: (a) एक अर्थव्यवस्था में; C=200+0.75 Y (जहाँ C= उपभोग व्यय है, तथा Y= राष्ट्रीय आय है) निवेश व्यय = ₹4,000 करोड़ है। निम्नलिखित की गणना करें : (i) आय का संतुलन स्तर (ii) आय के संतुलन स्तर पर कुल उपभोग व्यय
questions.text_english: (a) In an economy; C=200+0.75Y (where C is consumption expenditure and Y is National Income). Investment expenditure is 4,000 Crore. Calculate the following: (i) Equilibrium level of income. (ii) Total consumption expenditure at equilibrium income level.
questions.solution: At equilibrium, Y = C + I. Given C = 200 + 0.75Y and I = 4000, we substitute these: Y = 200 + 0.75Y + 4000. Solving for Y, we get 0.25Y = 4200, which means Y = 16800. Thus, the equilibrium level of income is 16800 crores. For consumption, we substitute Y in the consumption function: C = 200 + 0.75(16800) = 200 + 12600 = 12800 crores.

questions.text: मान लीजिए, किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में प्राथमिक जमा ₹500 है, यदि आरक्षित अनुपात 25% है। बैंकिंग प्रणाली द्वारा सृजित कुल जमा राशियों तथा कुल उधार (ऋण) का अनुमान लगाएँ ।
questions.text_english: Suppose in an economy, primary deposits are 500, if the Reserve Ratio is 25%. Estimate the total deposits created and the total lending by the banking system.

key_points: Total lending = Total deposits - Initial reserves = 2000 - 500 = 1500

questions.solution: The money multiplier is calculated as 1 divided by the reserve ratio, which is 1/0.25 = 4. The total deposits created by the banking system equals the initial primary deposits multiplied by the money multiplier, resulting in 500 * 4 = 2000 crores. Total lending by the banking system is the total deposits minus the initial reserves (primary deposits), which equals 2000 - 500 = 1500 crores.

questions.text:
केन्द्रीय खाद्य व उपभोक्ता मामले के मंत्री ने कहा कि, सरकार ने खाद्य वस्तुओं की खुदरा (retail) कीमतों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए विगत वर्षों में कई सक्रिय कदम उठाए हैं। उन्होंने कहा कि, सरकार का लक्ष्य राष्ट्र की आर्थिक वृद्धि से समझौता किए बिना मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रण में रखना है। नवंबर 2023 में खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति 5.55% के तीन माह के उच्चतम स्तर पर पहुँच गई, जो कि खाद्य पदार्थों की बढ़ती कीमतों के कारण है। अगस्त 2023 में मुद्रास्फीति में गिरावट आयी थी, जब यह 6.83% पर पहुँच गई थी । आवश्यक वस्तुओं की थोक (wholesale) व खुदरा (retail) मूल्यों पर कड़ी निगरानी रखने हेतु केन्द्र सरकार ने 140 नए मूल्य निगरानी केन्द्र स्थापित किए हैं।

सरकार ने गेहूँ, टूटे चावल, गैर-बासमती सफेद चावल, प्याज आदि कई खाद्य पदार्थों के निर्यात पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया है। घरेलू आपूर्ति को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए तथा मूल्य वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने के लिए सरकार ने तिलहन व दलहन पर आयात शुल्क भी कम कर दिया है।
questions.text_english:
Union Food and Consumer Affairs Minister said that the Central Government has taken many proactive steps in the past few years to control retail prices of food items. He said that the government aims to keep inflation under control without compromising the country's economic growth. Retail inflation inched up to a three-month high of 5.55% in November 2023 driven by higher food prices. Inflation has been declining since August 2023, when it touched 6.83%. 140 new price monitoring centres had been set up by the Central Government to keep a close watch on wholesale and retail prices of essential commodities.

The Government has banned the export of many food items like wheat, broken rice, non-basmati white rice, onions etc. It has also reduced import duties on edible oils and pulses to boost domestic supply and control price rise.

sub_questions.text: सरकार द्वारा स्थापित नए मूल्य निगरानी केन्द्रों की संख्या बताएँ ।
sub_questions.text_english: Mention the number of new price monitoring centres set up by government.
sub_questions.solution: The government has set up 140 new price monitoring centres.

sub_questions.text: घरेलू आपूर्ति को प्रोत्साहित करने व मूल्यों में कमी लाने के लिए सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए किन्हीं दो सक्रिय उपायों का उल्लेख करें ।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two proactive measures taken by government to boost domestic supply and reduction in prices.

key_points: Reducing import duties on edible oils and pulses.

sub_questions.solution: Two proactive measures taken by the government are banning the export of several food items like wheat, broken rice, and onions, and reducing import duties on edible oils and pulses to increase their availability in the domestic market.

sub_questions.text: मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रित करने के लिए प्रयुक्त किसी एक मौद्रिक उपाय की व्याख्या करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any one monetary measure used to control inflation.

key_points: Higher repo rate increases cost of borrowing.
This reduces money supply and aggregate demand.

sub_questions.solution: One monetary measure to control inflation is increasing the Repo Rate. When the central bank increases the repo rate, it becomes costlier for commercial banks to borrow funds from the central bank. Consequently, commercial banks increase their lending rates for the public. This leads to a reduction in demand for loans, which decreases the money supply and aggregate demand in the economy, ultimately helping to curb inflation.

questions.solution: Passage-based question set. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

questions.text: (a) (i) आय विधि द्वारा राष्ट्रीय आय का आकलन करते समय अपनाई जाने वाली किन्हीं दो सावधानियों की व्याख्या करें । (ii) "उच्च सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) का अर्थ सदैव अर्थव्यवस्था में वस्तुओं की प्रति व्यक्ति अधि-उपलब्धता होता है।" उपरोक्त कथन का उस देश के लोगों के कल्याण के सूचकांक के रूप में समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) (i) Explain any two precautions to be adopted while estimating National income by Income method. (ii) "Higher Gross Domestic Product (GDP) always means higher per capita availability of goods in the economy." Defend or refute the given statement as the index of welfare of the people of that country.

sub_questions.text: आय विधि द्वारा राष्ट्रीय आय का आकलन करते समय अपनाई जाने वाली किन्हीं दो सावधानियों की व्याख्या करें ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any two precautions to be adopted while estimating National income by Income method.

key_points: Income from sale of second-hand goods is excluded.

sub_questions.solution: Two precautions while using the income method include: firstly, transfer incomes such as old-age pensions or scholarships are excluded as they do not correspond to any productive service. Secondly, income from the sale of second-hand goods is excluded because it does not represent current production, and the value was already counted when the goods were originally produced.

sub_questions.text: "उच्च सकल घरेलू उत्पद (GDP) का अर्थ सदैव अर्थव्यवस्था में वस्तुओं की प्रति व्यक्ति अधि-उपलब्धता होता है।" उपरोक्त कथन का उस देश के लोगों के कल्याण के सूचकांक के रूप में समर्थन अथवा खंडन करें।
sub_questions.text_english: "Higher Gross Domestic Product (GDP) always means higher per capita availability of goods in the economy." Defend or refute the given statement as an index of the welfare of the people of that country.

key_points: GDP doesn't consider income distribution and non-monetary exchanges.

sub_questions.solution: This statement is refuted. A higher GDP does not automatically guarantee higher per capita availability or improved welfare. If the population growth rate exceeds the GDP growth rate, the per capita GDP will decline. Furthermore, GDP ignores income distribution—if the increase in GDP is concentrated among a few, the welfare of the masses may not improve. Additionally, GDP fails to account for external factors like environmental degradation and non-monetary transactions.

questions.solution: Long answer question with sub-parts.

questions.text: भारत निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्रीय / वैश्विक आर्थिक समूह का सदस्य नहीं है ?

Reason (R): Rate of participation of people refers to the percentage of people engaged in production process of a country.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) व कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.solution: Frictional unemployment is defined as the temporary unemployment that arises when people are moving between jobs.

questions.solution: The Great Leap Forward in China primarily focused on rapid industrialization, particularly through the promotion of small-scale industries and collective farming to boost industrial output.

questions.text: (a) "विगत समयावधि में सहकारी समितियों को झटका लगा है।" उपरोक्त कथन का वैध स्पष्टीकरण द्वारा औचित्य सिद्ध करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "Cooperatives have received a setback during the recent past." Justify the given statement with a valid explanation.
questions.solution: Cooperatives have faced setbacks due to several factors. Firstly, they have struggled with inefficient management and issues related to governance. Secondly, a lack of consistent policy support has hindered their growth compared to the competitive private sector. Lastly, they have often failed to adapt to changing market requirements, leading to a decline in their overall effectiveness in rural development.

questions.text: मानव पूँजी व आर्थिक विकास के मध्य संबंध स्थापित करें ।
questions.text_english: Trace the relationship between human capital and economic growth.

key_points: Education and skill lead to innovation.

questions.solution: Human capital and economic growth have a positive and direct relationship. Human capital formation through education and skill development enhances the productive capacity of the workforce. A healthier and better-educated population is more efficient, innovative, and capable of adopting new technologies, all of which drive higher output and accelerate the overall economic growth of a nation.

questions.text: पाकिस्तान द्वारा अपने आर्थिक विकास पथ के लिए उठाए गए विकासात्मक कदमों का वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: Describe the path of developmental initiatives taken by Pakistan for its economic development.

key_points: Shift towards deregulation and liberalization in 1980s.

questions.solution: Pakistan initiated its development path by focusing on import substitution industrialization. In the 1970s, it shifted to a mixed economy model, nationalizing several capital goods industries. However, in the 1980s, the focus moved toward deregulation and liberalization. Additionally, the government implemented various agricultural reforms, including policies aligned with the Green Revolution to increase productivity in the rural sector.

questions.text: (a) "पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में लघु जल विद्युत संयंत्र लागत प्रभावी होने के साथ-साथ पर्यावरण अनुकूल भी साबित होते हैं।" उपरोक्त कथन को प्रमाणित करें। (b) अवशोषण क्षमता को परिभाषित करें।
questions.text_english: (a) "In the mountainous regions, mini-hydel plants prove to be cost-effective as well as eco-friendly." Justify the above statement with valid arguments. (b) Define absorptive capacity.

key_points: Mini-hydel plants utilize local flowing water streams.
Low infrastructure costs compared to big dams.
Absorptive capacity is the ability of the environment to absorb degradation.

questions.solution: Mini-hydel plants are cost-effective in mountainous regions as they utilize local, fast-flowing water streams, eliminating the need for large-scale, expensive dam construction. They are eco-friendly because they require minimal land displacement and cause less ecological disruption to the natural habitat compared to large dams. Absorptive capacity is defined as the environment's ability to absorb or process the degradation caused by human activities without causing permanent damage to the ecosystem.

questions.text: (a) भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के योजना उद्देश्य के रूप में 'आत्म निर्भरता' के चयन के पीछे के तर्कों का संक्षिप्त वर्णन करें ।
questions.text_english: (a) Describe briefly a rationale behind choosing 'Self-reliance' as a planning objective for the Indian economy.

key_points: Protecting domestic industries from foreign influence.

questions.solution: Self-reliance was chosen as a planning objective to reduce India's dependency on foreign aid and imports, particularly in the aftermath of colonial rule. By prioritizing domestic production, the government aimed to protect local industries from foreign influence and competition, thereby ensuring long-term national sovereignty and economic stability. It was especially critical for ensuring self-sufficiency in essential sectors like food production to prevent vulnerability to external political or economic shocks.

questions.text:
कृषि-स्टार्टअप व ग्रामीण उद्यम भारत में ग्रामीण विकास के लिए तीव्रता से महत्वपूर्ण होते जा रहे हैं। वे भारत में ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में आने वाली गंभीर चुनौतियों का समाधान प्रस्तुत करते हैं। ये उद्यम उन्नत कृषि, IT-आधारित निगरानी प्रणाली व डेटा आधारित निर्णय लेने वाले उपकरण जैसे तकनीकी नवाचार लाते हैं, जो उत्पादकता व संसाधन दक्षता में वृद्धि करते हैं।

आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को सुव्यवस्थित करके व प्रत्यक्ष बाजार से संपर्क स्थापित करके वे कृषकों के लिए उचित मूल्य निर्धारण सुनिश्चित करते हैं तथा पारंपरिक बिचौलियों पर निर्भरता भी कम करते हैं। ऐसे उद्यम ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में रोजगार सृजन में सक्रिय रूप से योगदान प्रदान करते हैं। सरकार ने RKVY-RAFTAAR, कृषि अवसंरचना कोष तथा Agri-SURE आदि विभिन्न कार्यक्रमों के माध्यम से कृषि स्टार्टअपों व उद्यमियों के लिए निरंतर नीति व वित्तीय सहायता का प्रदर्शन किया है।
questions.text_english:
Agro-startups and rural enterprises are becoming increasingly vital for rural development in India. They address the critical challenges faced by rural sector in India. These ventures bring in technological innovations such as precision farming, IT-based monitoring system and data-driven decision making tools that enhance productivity and resource efficiency.

By streamlining supply chains and creating direct market linkages, they ensure better pricing for farmers and reduce dependency on traditional intermediaries. Such enterprises contribute actively to employment generation in the rural areas. The government has demonstrated a continuous policy and financial support for agri-startups and entrepreneurs through various programs like RKVY-RAFTAAR, the Agri-infrastructure fund and Agri-SURE.

sub_questions.text: उल्लेख करें कि किस प्रकार कृषि-स्टार्टअप कृषि क्षेत्र में आने वाली गंभीर चुनौतियों का समाधान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain, how agro-startups address the critical challenges faced by the agricultural sector.

key_points: Ensures fair pricing and removes intermediaries.

sub_questions.solution: Agro-startups address critical agricultural challenges by introducing technological innovations like precision farming and IT-based monitoring systems, which significantly boost productivity and resource efficiency. They also streamline the supply chain and establish direct market linkages, which ensures better pricing for farmers and reduces their dependency on traditional, exploitative intermediaries.

sub_questions.text: भारत में कृषि स्टार्टअपों व उद्यमियों को समर्थन देने में सरकार की भूमिका पर टिप्पणी करें।
sub_questions.text_english: Comment on the role of government in supporting agro-startups and entrepreneurs in India.
sub_questions.solution: The government plays a crucial role by providing consistent policy and financial support to agri-startups. This is executed through various focused programs such as RKVY-RAFTAAR, the Agri-infrastructure fund, and Agri-SURE, which help entrepreneurs innovate and scale their operations to benefit the rural economy.

questions.solution: Passage-based question set.

questions.text: (a) मान्य कारणों द्वारा उल्लेखित करें कि, निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य है अथवा असत्य : (i) विश्व व्यापार संगठन का उद्देश्य विश्व व्यापार में नियम आधारित व्यवस्था स्थापित करना है। (ii) क्षेत्रीय असमानता के साथ आर्थिक विकास भारत में नियोजन का प्रमुख लक्ष्य था । (iii) औपनिवेशिक काल के अंतर्गत, खेतीगत कुल क्षेत्रफल के विस्तार के कारण कृषि क्षेत्र में वृद्धि हुई थी ।
questions.text_english: (a) Giving valid reasons, state whether the following statements are true or false. (i) There was growth in agricultural sector due to expansion of aggregate area under cultivation, during the colonial era. (ii) The objective of World Trade Organisation (WTO) is to establish a rule based regime, in the world trade. (iii) Economic growth with regional disparity was the main goal of planning in India.

sub_questions.text: विश्व व्यापार संगठन का उद्देश्य विश्व व्यापार में नियम आधारित व्यवस्था स्थापित करना है।
sub_questions.text_english: The objective of World Trade Organisation (WTO) is to establish a rule based regime, in the world trade.

key_points: WTO creates rules for trade between nations to ensure smooth and fair commerce.

sub_questions.solution: True. The WTO was established to create and administer a rule-based system for international trade, ensuring that trade among nations is as smooth, predictable, and free as possible.

sub_questions.text: क्षेत्रीय असमानता के साथ आर्थिक विकास भारत में नियोजन का प्रमुख लक्ष्य था ।
sub_questions.text_english: Economic growth with regional disparity was the main goal of planning in India.

key_points: Goal was growth with 'equity' and 'balanced regional development'.

sub_questions.solution: False. The main goals of Indian planning were growth, equity, and balanced regional development. Reducing regional disparities was a key objective, not promoting them.

sub_questions.text: औपनिवेशिक काल के अंतर्गत, खेतीगत कुल क्षेत्रफल के विस्तार के कारण कृषि क्षेत्र में वृद्धि हुई थी ।
sub_questions.text_english: There was growth in agricultural sector due to expansion of aggregate area under cultivation, during the colonial era.

key_points: Expansion of land led to some growth, though productivity remained low.

sub_questions.solution: True. During the colonial era, the total area under cultivation did expand, which contributed to some growth in the agricultural sector, even though agricultural productivity remained stagnation and low due to exploitative land tenure systems.
